definitions.label: Account equity
definitions.method: Broker-observed account equity or explicitly dated executor report

definitions.label: Gross exposure
definitions.method: Sum of absolute observed position market values divided by observed equity
definitions.availability: Requires matching account and position valuation observations

definitions.label: Unrealized P&L
definitions.method: Broker position unrealized P&L using broker cost-basis convention
definitions.availability: Requires position valuation and cost basis

definitions.label: Observed equity change
definitions.method: Last observed equity / first observed equity - 1; raw equity change can include external cash flows and is not automatically a strategy return
definitions.availability: Requires at least two valid equity observations

definitions.label: Observed equity drawdown
definitions.method: Observed equity / running peak observed equity - 1; raw account equity is not cash-flow adjusted
definitions.availability: Requires a valid equity curve; sample period must be displayed

definitions.label: Sharpe (engine definition)
definitions.method: Display exact producer methodology and risk-free convention; existing CAGR/annualized-volatility measure differs from arithmetic excess-return Sharpe
definitions.availability: Only use source-supplied validated metric; short/gapped paper samples remain insufficient

definitions.label: Daemon progress age
definitions.method: Current UTC - heartbeat last_success_at; native health threshold 1800 seconds
definitions.availability: Missing, corrupt or future heartbeat is unhealthy

definitions.label: Observation age
definitions.method: Current UTC - authoritative source observation time; file modification time alone does not prove a fresh observation
definitions.availability: Requires a parseable source observation time

definitions.label: Event observation lag
definitions.method: Adapter observed_at - native occurred_at; delivery order is not causal order
definitions.availability: Requires both source and adapter timestamps
